ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Saturn

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up home and family.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1814773220000}, the Moon is still in {S:3} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.
